label: Macau–HK deep dive split by day
notes: v1: initial v2.2 content manifest. v2: Settings footer test change. v3: Macau-HK deep dive guide + 8-stop audio tour. v4: content version display + honest update feedback in Settings, index.html and esim-usage.json excluded from the manifest (shell frame and volatile usage file), and the Huangshan Baiyun confirmation image added to the overlay. v5: Oct 28 Macao arrival day in full detail in all three day-plan options (corrected MF8719 2:45 PM departure, 12:15 hotel departure, T4 check-in, optional CZBANK tax refund, Venetian shuttle + indoor walk to Four Seasons, MGM Cotai rewards + Spectacle, Rua do Cunha evening, two Taipa dinner options); docs/itineraries.json re-merged from content/ (built file was stale since Oct 17). v6: app.js fix — the bundled (APK) load path now also fetches itineraries.json through the content-updater interception, so day-plan changes published as content updates (like v5's Oct 28 plan) actually reach the installed app; previously the APK used only the itinerary inlined at build time. Falls back to the inlined copy on any failure. v7: Settings > Content updates now shows what's actually on this phone — installed content version (re-fetched live when Settings opens and after every check), the number of downloaded content files overriding the bundle, and a fingerprint of the itinerary in use (Oct 28 stop count + first stop + data date) — so a stale display can't hide behind 'up to date'. v8: the Macau–Hong Kong deep dive is split per day at Justin's request — Oct 28 gets Macau (customs, apps, top 10, Stop 1), Oct 29 gets Taipa morning (Stop 2) + the Hong Kong arrival reference (customs, apps, top 10, Stop 3), Oct 30 gets Stops 4–5, Oct 31 gets Stops 6–7, Nov 1 gets Stop 8. Each day page now shows only its own deep dive; the combined guide remains as fallback until the split files download. android/build-apk.sh now inlines the five per-day guides for future APK builds.
